summary: REQ-13 and REQ-14 appear to be implemented: backend adds a caller-scoped feedback query and frontend hook switches to it. However, the backend implementation of getCallerFeedback is truncated in the diff, so it’s not fully verifiable that it returns the filtered array correctly.
